name: sqlite-mcp
description: Adds Google's MCP Toolbox for Databases with its prebuilt SQLite tools (execute_sql, list_tables) for local database querying and analysis. The database is ave.sqlite in the package's data folder. From 2026.10.25 it replaces the archived reference SQLite server and keeps the same file, so existing data stays. Toolbox ships no Linux arm64 build.
